areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: Relevant objectives and SMART indicator, relevant resources and high impact, but the component does not prioritize the area and is shared with education.

areas.name: Early childhood and education
areas.reason: Related objectives and products, but the indicator measures sensory-room implementation rather than access or quality, and resources are low.

areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: Specific objective related, but the programme is not centred on rights of oppressed groups; the indicator has low relevance and impact is limited.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Relevant objectives and SMART indicators on integrated mobility, sanitation and waste, but moderate impact given low resource share and beneficiaries.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Integrated products and SMART flood-prevention indicator, relevant resources and wide benefit, giving high impact.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Suitable specific objective and relevant indicator, but the water-quality action covers few areas and resources are low.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Digital public-service subcomponent, two SMART indicators with viable targets, several departments affected and relevant resources, giving high impact.

areas.name: Women
